desc:
🚕 Drive your own taxi through Berlin! Pick up passengers, load their luggage and work your way up from an old rust bucket to a luxury limo. 💶

📱 Accept rides on your phone, follow the route and drive smoothly – happy passengers give ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ and bigger tips!

✨ FEATURES
🚖 25 taxis inspired by real cars: EVs, vans and a classic from 1969
🧳 Tourists, business people, night owls and seniors
🔥 Hotspot hunts and night shift bonus
🏆 7 driver ranks, daily tasks and badges
👥 Play with friends as passengers or co-drivers
🌙 Real Berlin time with day, night and changing weather
🚦 AI traffic, traffic lights and red-light cameras
📸 Cockpit view, photo mode and car radio with 4 stations
🔖 Your own custom license plate (gamepass)
🔒 Private servers: set the weather and time yourself

🎓 Start at the driving school with your examiner – then hit the streets!
🆓 Free to play · 💻📱🎮 PC, phone, tablet & console · 🇬🇧🇩🇪 English & German
